For me in Mint 17.3 + Cinnamon, there are TWO things I have to make sure of.

First, in nVidia Settings, there is a checkbox in the OpenGL section (I think) for "enable vsync". This has to be on.

Second, there is an option to "disable compositing for fullscreen applications". Compositing is the process of taking all the stuff that's supposed to be on the monitor and putting it all together (like the contents of overlapping windows). Since games are usually played a full screen, there is no need to do the compositing process (game is already doing it), so you COULD turn it off. But if you do, you may get tearing.

Thirdly, maybe, there is a VSYNC option in the game itself. Theoretically, the OpenGL setting should override it, but it doesn't help to try there, too.
